html:
Our Applications Industries

Oil and Gas

Rotary gear pumps ensure efficient transfer of crude oil, refined products, and lubricants in demanding oil and gas operations.

Chemical Processing

Designed for safe and precise handling of corrosive, viscous, and hazardous chemicals in industrial chemical processing applications. 

Pharmaceuticals

Ideal for hygienic and contamination-free transfer of pharmaceutical liquids, syrups, and sensitive solutions requiring precision and reliability. 

Food and Beverage

Ensure safe, hygienic transfer of edible oils, syrups, and dairy products, maintaining quality and taste standards in food processing. 

Agriculture

Efficiently handle pesticides, fertilizers, and other agricultural fluids, ensuring consistent performance in farming and irrigation systems.

Paints and Dyes

Specialized for transferring highly viscous paints, coatings, and dyes, ensuring smooth flow without contamination or product loss. 

Lubrication Systems

Precisely pump lubricants, oils, and grease in industrial machinery, improving performance and reducing equipment wear and tear.

Cosmetics Industry

Handle viscous creams, lotions, and liquid products hygienically, ensuring consistency and quality in cosmetics manufacturing processes. 

Medical Industry

Rotary gear pumps ensure precise and hygienic handling of medical fluids, ointments, and solutions, supporting critical healthcare manufacturing processes.

Dairy Industry

Rotary gear pumps ensure hygienic transfer of milk, cream, yogurt, and other dairy products, maintaining quality and safety standards.

Sugar Industry

Specialized for handling viscous liquids like syrups and molasses, rotary gear pumps ensure smooth, consistent flow in sugar processing.

Textile Industry

Efficiently handle dyes, chemicals, and lubricants used in textile manufacturing, ensuring precise application and smooth operations.
